note: Initial thresholds for the mastering planner, the verifier and the Mix Report. Every value here is an initial / practice-level value ([慣行]) subject to calibration (docs/SPEC.md 4.3, 4.9). Safety invariants themselves (S-nn) are never relaxed; only their numeric limits marked 'initial' are calibratable. Profile-specific values in profiles/media_profiles.json take precedence over the generic defaults here.

gr_p95_warn_db.note: Limiter GR 95th percentile above this is a warning sign of a mix-side problem (SPEC 6.6.3: 'constantly above 4-5 dB').

gr_p95_send_back_db.note: Above this the planner lowers the loudness target within the profile window; if still above, it sends back to the mix stage (R-14).

sustained_fraction_gt_1db.note: Fraction of time with GR > 1 dB above which limiting is considered sustained rather than occasional.

gr_max_note_db.note: Max GR above this is reported as a listening point (transient damage risk), not a failure by itself.

max_abs_gain_db.note: Master EQ moves stay within about +/-2 dB (R-06, R-15). Larger needs are a mix problem.

linear_phase_max_cut_db.note: Linear-phase EQ at the master stage is limited to small cuts (SPEC 6.6.3).

min_deviation_to_act_db.note: Deviation of a broad band from the generic prior needed before a corrective move is proposed. The generic prior is wide on purpose (SPEC 4.6 item 3).

correction_fraction.note: Only part of a measured deviation is corrected at the master stage (small moves, R-06).

generic_tonal_prior.note: Broad generic prior for full-mix band energy ratios (P-07) used only when no reference set exists. Wide on purpose; not genre-specific (SPEC 4.6 item 3). Values are fractions of total energy (K-weighting not applied).

negative_corr_threshold.note: Correlation below this in a window counts as negative.

window_s.note: Analysis window for the persistence check.

max_persistence_s.note: Longest allowed run of consecutive negative-correlation windows below the boundary.

max_negative_fraction.note: Largest allowed fraction of windows with negative low-band correlation.

low_band_max_db.note: Max level loss on mono fold below the low-band boundary.

lead_clarity_max_db.note: Max level loss on mono fold in the lead clarity band (full-mix proxy for the lead element).

planner_mono_bass_trigger_db.note: Mono loss below the boundary above which the planner proposes mono below the boundary.

codec_after_ceiling_dbtp.note: Default codec-after true-peak ceiling (D-046). Profiles may override with true_peak.codec_after_ceiling_dbtp.

bitrates.note: Round-trip bitrates per codec, close to what platforms deliver. A higher bitrate usually gives a smaller overshoot; values are calibratable.

ceiling_step_db.note: Limiter ceiling is lowered by this step per S-02 re-render iteration.

max_iterations.note: Max S-02 re-render iterations per output; on exhaustion the output fails S-02 and is reported.

tolerance_lu.note: Planner aims at the target; verification uses the profile window. The tolerance is used by the gain stage when deciding whether a re-trim is needed.

nonnormalized_step_lu.note: Step by which the planner lowers the target within the window when P-18 is exceeded.

window_floor_margin_lu.note: The lowest target the planner tries stays this far above the window floor, leaving room for the S-02 ceiling reduction at render time.

p20_shrink_warn_lu.note: Warn when the short-term loudness contrast between quiet and loud sections shrinks by more than this (P-20, R-26). Fully evaluated from M3.

excessive_above_db.note: Above this, compression is excessive (vocabulary: flat / squashed).

dc_offset_max.note: Max absolute mean per channel (linear, -50 dBFS) not inherited from the input. Heavy limiting of asymmetric transients shifts the mean by about -60 to -55 dBFS, which is harmless; a DC fault is a larger offset. Calibratable.

clip_sample_abs.note: Samples at or above full scale count as clipped for fixed-point outputs.

length_tolerance_samples.note: Output length must equal input length scaled by the rate ratio within this many samples.

plan_margin_db.note: The mastering planner requires every S-08 delta of the simulated master to stay this far inside the S-08 tolerance (knowledge/cleanup_policy.json s08), because render-time resampling, dither and the S-02 ceiling loop move the measured value slightly. This tightens planning only; the verify tolerance is never relaxed (SPEC 4.3).

hf_boost_min_hz.note: A master EQ boost centred at or above this frequency (or any high-shelf boost) counts as an HF boost; on an S-08 failure it is reduced first (SPEC 6.7).

hf_boost_reduction_factors.note: Steps applied to the HF boost gains on an S-08 failure (50 %, then removed).

normalized_limiter_variants.note: Normalized media keep their loudness target (it is the delivery gate); on an S-08 failure these limiter drive variants are tried in order: release time (limiter gain recovery modulates the noise in quiet frames and the HF band) and a soft clipper placed clipper_headroom_db above the limiter ceiling (at most 0 dBFS) taking part of the peaks. Non-normalized media lower the target within the window instead (a clipper would hide limiter dependency, R-14).
